levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بنالوليد

notes: «حَدَّثَنا أَبي» names the father only as «أبي»: relation (rule 7); «رحمهما اللَّه» is a blessing: left out

«كَانَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ ... وَاقِفاً بِعَرَفَةَ يَدْعُو» describes the Imam's act, but «فَسُئِلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَدْعُو» gives his words: the Imam who speaks in the narrator's story is the last link (owner ruling 5)
the text writes «بنالوليد» and «لحكم» without the space and article: the surfaces copy them as written
the Imam is not identified beyond the name the report gives
